citation: French et al. (2024), Table 3, reproducing Karkoschka (2001) Voyager paper TableV; adopted prolate axes also in Karkoschka HST paper TableIV.
orientation: IAU/WGCCRE BODY706 frame from pinned PCK. Published prolate interpretation assumes the long axis toward Uranus and the other axes equal.
qualification: Published size and elongation fit, not a detailed terrain mesh. The third semi-axis 18 km is the prolate assumption, not an independent measurement. Reported uncertainties apply to projected radius sqrt(A*B) and ratioB/A; no separate-axis error bars are invented.
